components.name: Primary app-release link
components.description: The clearest route from the product page to the latest public application release.
components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 3.15rem; gap: .75rem; padding: .8rem 1.15rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: .45rem; color: #fff; background: #214b9a; font: 720 1rem/1.2 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #193c7e; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6c3fd1; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Scroll-synchronized audit journey
components.description: A sticky real screenshot follows the narrative step that enters the central viewport band; route anchors select a stage directly.
components.html:
Observer une page

Le site observé reste relié à son dossier.
components.css: .ds-journey { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(20rem, .85fr); align-items: start; gap: 4rem; } .ds-journey-media { position: sticky; top: 1.2rem; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #cbd5e4; border-radius: .65rem; background: #eef2fa; } .ds-journey-media img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; transition: opacity 240ms ease, transform 420ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-journey-media figcaption { padding: .7rem .9rem; border-top: 1px solid #d5ddea; color: #45536d; background: #fffdf7; font: 400 .8rem/1.4 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', sans-serif; } .ds-journey-step { display: flex; min-height: 30rem; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding-block: 3rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #cfd7e5; } .ds-journey-step h2 { color: #214b9a; font: 730 clamp(1.7rem,2.7vw,2.5rem)/1.12 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next',sans-serif; } .ds-journey-step p { color: #45536d; font: 400 1.0625rem/1.58 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next',sans-serif; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-journey-media img{transition:none}}

components.name: Product screenshot frame
components.description: A genuine RGAA Studio screenshot with a thin frame and explanatory caption.
components.css: .ds-screenshot { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #cfd7e5; border-radius: .65rem; background: #fffdf7; } .ds-screenshot img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; } .ds-screenshot figcaption { padding: .72rem 1rem; color: #45536d; background: #f7f7f3; font: 400 .77rem/1.5 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: The site makes the connection between an observed page, review aids, the auditor’s decision, and recorded evidence visible as an interactive sequence. It keeps the product itself in view: supplied application screenshots are evidence of the interface, while the sticky capture follows the explanation as the visitor scrolls. The language is direct and French-first, for auditors and organizations evaluating the tool. The visual system extends RGAA Studio’s actual desktop palette and icon, with a legible self-hosted typeface and open, low-density page sections. The publisher remains a factual footer attribution; the product icon and name carry the main identity.
keyCharacteristics: A stage index and scroll-synchronized evidence view instead of a row of equal feature cards.
Blue signals actions and navigable audit stages.
Genuine application screenshots, captioned and described.
Automated analyses are presented as review aids, never as conformity results.

rules.name: The Route-Blue Rule
rules.body: Audit Blue marks navigation and action; it never communicates a conformity result by itself.

dos: Do keep the sequence between page, review aids, human judgment, and evidence explicit.
Do keep release discovery direct and label each external destination.
Do describe automated signals as suggestions and actual decisions as the auditor’s responsibility.
Do use supplied product screenshots with their provenance and meaningful alternatives.
donts: Don't imply that the tool issues a compliance verdict or that its automated coverage is complete.
Don't imply audit-dossier synchronization or collaborative account features.
Don't add testimonial, client, benchmark, pricing, or outcome claims without verified source material.
Don't hide essential content behind motion or replace the product interface with a generic device mockup.
